BETA Close X CRH plc announced that on February 27, 2026, it acquired a total of 58,418 of its ordinary shares through Wells Fargo Securities, LLC, with an aggregated volume-weighted average price of $118.3596 per share. These acquisitions, which are part of CRH's share buyback program up to $300 million, will be cancelled. Following these transactions, CRH will have 669,930,581 ordinary shares in issue, excluding treasury shares, and will hold 35,661,896 ordinary shares in treasury, representing 5.054% of the issued ordinary share capital. Disclaimer* 2 nd March 2026 CRH plc Transaction in Own Shares CRH plc (“ CRH ”) announces that on 27 th February 2026 it acquired the following number of its ordinary shares (the “ ordinary shares ”) in the United States through CRH’s broker Wells Fargo Securities, LLC. The ordinary shares acquired (by way of redemption) will be cancelled. Following settlement of the above transactions and subsequent share cancellation CRH will have 669,930,581 ordinary shares in issue (excluding treasury shares). CRH will also hold 35,661,896 of its ordinary shares in treasury, which represents 5.054% of the issued ordinary share capital of CRH. Ordinary shares held in treasury do not have any voting rights.
